# MD2PDF

> Free online Markdown to PDF converter. Convert .md files to beautifully styled PDFs, HTML, and images with 11 visual styles, Mermaid diagrams, auto table of contents, and syntax highlighting for 180+ languages. No signup; conversion runs entirely in the browser and share links are end-to-end encrypted (AES-256-GCM) before upload. Includes an npm CLI and MCP server (md2pdf-studio), a public REST API and an installable AI Skill for Claude, Codex and other AI agents.

Last updated: 2026-10-06

## Main

- [MD2PDF App](https://md2pdf.studio/): Online Markdown editor with live preview, 11 visual styles, Mermaid diagrams, TOC, and export to PDF/HTML/image
- [About MD2PDF](https://md2pdf.studio/about): Background, features, and how it works
- [Full AI Documentation](https://md2pdf.studio/llms-full.txt): Complete reference for LLMs — features, API, AI Skill, styles, and usage
- [AI Skill (downloadable)](https://md2pdf.studio/skill.md): Installable skill file for Claude, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and compatible agents

## API

- [CLI and MCP server — npx -y md2pdf-studio@0.1.1](https://md2pdf.studio/llms-full.txt): `npx -y md2pdf-studio@0.1.1 share file.md` encrypts locally and prints the private link; also update, delete, list, `--expires`, `--burn` (one-time links), and an MCP server over stdio.
- [Create Document — POST /api/save](https://md2pdf.studio/llms-full.txt): Encrypt locally with AES-256-GCM, send ciphertext with header X-Encrypted: aes-256-gcm. Plaintext is rejected. The server never sees plaintext or key.
- [Update Document — PUT /api/update/{id}](https://md2pdf.studio/llms-full.txt): Reuse editKey. Send X-Encrypted: aes-256-gcm with fresh ciphertext and the same key.

## Styles

- [Style Gallery](https://md2pdf.studio/styles/): Browse all 11 visual styles with previews and use cases
- [Notion](https://md2pdf.studio/styles/notion): Clean modern sans-serif (default)
- [GitHub](https://md2pdf.studio/styles/github): Classic GitHub markdown rendering
- [LaTeX](https://md2pdf.studio/styles/latex): Academic paper typography
- [Dracula](https://md2pdf.studio/styles/dracula): Vibrant dark theme
- [Terminal](https://md2pdf.studio/styles/terminal): Green-on-black monospace
- [All styles...](https://md2pdf.studio/styles/): Minimal, Academic, Corporate, Newspaper, Handwritten, Pastel
